representation.dimensions: nonempty tuple of strictly positive Python integers, excluding booleans
representation.dimension: product of dimensions, without qubit padding
representation.basis_index: left-to-right mixed-radix index with every occupation in range

implementation_order: approve and merge this contract with its test-only fake and conformance tests
implement the internal Core type behind the same consumer-level tests
extend existing static CPU dynamics, sealed plans, and gradients
deliver two physical models through the same existing solver and result path
refusals: empty, non-integer, boolean, zero, or negative dimensions
basis occupations with a wrong arity or an out-of-range value
a constrained fusion-space descriptor passed as product dimensions
implicit equivalence of a four-level subsystem and two qubits
qubit-specific operator descriptors interpreted in a non-qubit space

proposed_api_delta.existing_qubit_plan_identity: unchanged; explicitly all-qubit dimensions normalize to the existing form

not_implemented_by_this_contract: production mixed-dimension plan or execution entry point
constrained fusion-space type or anyon operations
photonic, hardware, GPU, or distributed dynamics backend
new IR, pass manager, numerical core, or training lifecycle
